prompt: Create a vertical digital collage illustration in a warm, handmade paper-cut style. The background is a textured off-white paper surface with subtle creases and torn edges. In the center, there is a large coffee mug made of brown kraft paper with visible tape marks. Rising from the mug are three wavy strips of white paper representing steam. Above the mug sits a cheerful yellow sun character made of crumpled yellow paper, featuring simple black dot eyes, a curved smile, and pink circular cheeks. Attached to the side of the mug is a tea bag tag made of white paper with a small orange flower doodle and the text 'Claude' written in a handwritten font. At the bottom right, there are three dark brown coffee beans and two green dried leaves taped onto the background. On the right side, there is a vertical column of Chinese calligraphy text: '早安' (Good Morning) at the top, followed by smaller text '问候' (Greetings), then a sentence '今天也请温柔地开始。' (Please start gently today as well). Below that is the date '2026-10-14' and the English text 'Morning Note'. The overall aesthetic should be cozy, tactile, and artistic.

promptZh: 创作一幅垂直构图的数字拼贴插画，采用温暖的手工剪纸风格。背景为带有细微褶皱和撕裂边缘的米白色纹理纸面。画面中央是一个由棕色牛皮纸制成的大咖啡杯，表面可见胶带痕迹。杯口上方升起三条波浪状的白色纸条，象征蒸汽。杯子上方坐落着一个欢快的黄色太阳角色，由揉皱的黄纸制成，拥有简单的黑色圆点眼睛、弯曲的微笑和粉色圆形脸颊。杯子侧面附有一个白色纸质茶包标签，上面绘有橙色小花涂鸦，并以手写字体写着“Claude”。右下角有三颗深棕色咖啡豆和两片绿色干叶被胶带固定在背景上。右侧有一列竖排中文书法文字：顶部为“早安”，下方是较小的“问候”，接着是一句“今天也请温柔地开始。”其下是日期“2026-10-14”和英文文本“Morning Note”。整体美学应呈现舒适、触感丰富且富有艺术感的效果。
